structure: thin-plate V-notch weir, 90 degrees nominal, plate worn, stilling well upstream

barometer.clock: its own clock, set by hand at installation

tailwater_gauge: downstream pool, head above the crest on the logger clock, negative below the crest

plate.seal: plate bolted to the sill, no seal strip

gauging_meter.clock: injection and samples in logger-clock minutes
gauging_meter.place: below the pool, beyond the mixing length
